systemic_fix: If you change one process this week: give every account ONE named owner who sends a short written Friday update (numbers, what shipped, open items with dates). Both churn post-mortems, both saves, and 15 of 19 analyst top-fixes point at this same move. The team broadcast draft is ready below.
team_broadcast: Team — three changes effective today. 1) Every client now has ONE named owner (list coming this afternoon) — if you see a client question, tag the owner, and owners: nothing sits unanswered past 24h, even if the answer is 'checking, back to you Thursday'. 2) Every Friday each owner posts a short written update in their client's chat: numbers, what shipped, open items with dates. Clients who can't see the work assume there isn't any — that's how we lost Paige. 3) Credentials NEVER go in group chats again — not asked for, not posted. Anything currently sitting in a chat gets rotated this week. No exceptions on any of the three.
pattern: Pressure replaced service this week: Sep 1 invoices carried first-ever "pay within 7 days to avoid pausing of work" threats — including to clients whose payment blockers are OURS — while 7-reels/week content mandates landed on five accounts, one of them recovering from surgery. Quiet clients got demands instead of check-ins.
integrity: ~9 messages were deleted from Vicky's chat within 48h of her termination — including her posted OF password and her "who did this?" message about the unauthorized post. The password was never rotated: the record was removed without fixing the exposure. Worth finding out who deleted them and why.
